test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

(a) All dogs are mammals.

(b) No animals are dogs.

Conclusion:

(i) No animals are mammals.

(ii) Some animals are not mammals

(iii) No dogs are animals.

(iv) All mammals are dogs
solution:
Given Statements:

(a) All dogs are mammals.

(b) No animals are dogs.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b741e9b000eb6d2157edecb3f72382fde2aa8eb973e113f82c607e5c4a0a3956.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No animals are mammals. → False (There is no definite relation between mammals and animals, so this can be a possibility only.)

II. Some animals are not mammals → False (There is no definite relation between mammals and animals, so this can be a possibility only.)

III. No dogs are animals → True (No animals are dogs, this implies that no dogs are animals).

IV. All mammals are dogs → False (All dogs are mammals, this implies that some mammals are dogs).

So, only the conclusion (lll) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
